He is depicted as the God of Mischief and initially nemesis to his adopted brother, Thor.

Raised as a master of Asgardian magic and sorcery, Loki plots to take the Asgardian throne from Thor. After that fails, he attempts to conquer Earth, inadvertently driving the formation of the Avengers, but is imprisoned in Asgard. He briefly replaces his adoptive father, Odin, as Asgard's ruler, then turns antihero and helps his brother save the planet from their sister Hela, before being killed by Thanos. An alternate version of Loki from 2012 is recruited by the Time Variance Authority (TVA) and encounters other versions of himself, including a female version named Sylvie, with whom he falls in love. They work together with TVA members Mobius, Hunter B-15 and Ouroboros to stop He Who Remains. The alternate version of Loki later sacrifices himself to watch over and maintain the multiverse.

As of 2024, Loki has become a staple in the MCU appearing in seven films, beginning with Thor (2011). Alternate versions of the character starred in the Disney+ television series Loki (2021–2023) and appeared in What If...? (2021–2024). He is considered a fan-favorite character in the franchise; Hiddleston's performance has received critical acclaim from critics and audiences.

entities.name: Ant
entities.description:
Ants are insects that have appeared in two Indiana Jones sets and one Ant-Man set. They are reddish black and dark grey dual-colour in the Indiana Jones sets, and a dark blue in Ant-Man. They haven't appeared in any sets since.

In Kingdom of the Crystal Skull, Indiana Jones and the villainous Russians encounter deadly siafu ants (army ants). These ants unsuccessfully attempt to eat Indy and his friends, but are successful in devouring the brutal Colonel Dovchenko.

In Ant-Man, the play a more helpful role. Ant-Man controls them to help him. A larger, brick-built ant with wings also appears in the set (nicknamed "Anty" in the film.)

entities.name: Apatosaurus
entities.description:
As one of the 3-in-1 models featured in 6914 Prehistoric Hunters, the Apatosaurus is comprised largely of bright red, dark red, and Brick Yellow bricks. It measures over 11 inches (29cm) long and has an opening mouth, a movable tail, and poseable legs.

Apatosaurus (meaning “Deceptive Lizard”) is an extinct sauropod found commonly in USA.

Apatosaurus appears as one of the 20 dinosaurs that are featured in the game. It only appears physically in "Gyrosphere Valley" where several are seen in the Gyrosphere attraction. It is also the sauropod skeleton seen in the Visitor Center in the Jurassic Park levels of the game.

The amber of Apatosaurus is found in the level "Commuications Center" and collecting the bone boxe minikits of that level unlocks the skeleton skin for Apatosaurus. As a playable dinosaur, it can stomp on the ground to break objects like Brachiosaurus.

entities.name: Aragog
entities.description:
Aragog is a brick built Harry Potter animal figure first introduced in 2002.

Aragog was Hagrid's giant spider. He lived in a large cave in the Dark Forest outside Hogwarts. He had hundreds of acromantula children. His brothers and sisters are evil, but don't attack the school only because of him. In Harry Potter's second year, he and Ron Weasley meet Aragog and are almost killed by him and his family. During Harry's sixth year, Aragog dies, to Hagrid's dismay. Professor Horace Slughorn held an unofficial funeral for Aragog, and entitled him "King of the Acromantulas." Due to his death, his siblings seized the chance to attack the school during the Battle of Hogwarts, nearly killing Hagrid. The spiders eventually run away to the forest.

entities.name: Arnold
entities.description:
Arnold the Pygmy Puff is the pet of Ginny Weasley, who appears in LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5-7. Since it is a pet, it can be sent into tubes.

In August 1996, Ginny Weasley bought Arnold the Pygmy Puff from her brothers, Fred and George Weasley from their shop, Weasley's Wizard Wheezes. Arnold enjoyed playing in front of the fireplace in the Gryffindor common room at Hogwarts, and sitting on Ginny's shoulder, where it often attracted the attention of Crookshanks, Hermione Granger's cat.
